consoleShell: Rasi admin console, desktop 1440px wide, light theme, IBM Plex Sans. Left sidebar 240px, white with a right hairline: brand at top (a small teal rounded square with a white 'R' and the word 'Rasi'); grouped navigation with tiny uppercase group labels — OPERATE: Dashboard, Collections, Cash; RECORDS: Customers, Lines, Sectors, Team; SYSTEM: Notifications, Audit log — Phosphor regular icons; the current item has a teal wash background, teal text and a 2px teal bar at its left edge. Top bar 52px, white, bottom hairline: current area name at left in muted text; at right a bell icon with a small coral count badge '3' and an account button (teal-wash circle with initials 'LK', name 'Lakshmi K', role 'Admin' underneath, small chevron). Page body on the mint canvas background, max width 1152px, 32px padding, 28px between sections. Page header: breadcrumb trail in small muted text, a 26px semibold title, an optional meta line, page actions right-aligned, and a hairline rule under the header. Money always in Indian format with ₹ and tabular figures, e.g. ₹1,23,456.50. Use Indian names and shops only.
juniorShell: Rasi field app for a Junior collector, mobile 390px, light theme, IBM Plex Sans, used one-handed outdoors. No sidebar, no tab bar. A fixed top status bar: at left a green dot and 'Online' (or amber 'Offline'), in the middle a small amber pill '2 not sent' when entries are queued, at right a bell icon. 16px side padding, every tap target at least 44px tall, body text 16px, amounts 20–24px semibold with tabular figures. Money in Indian format with ₹. Never show invested amount or profit.

screens.prompt: Sign-in screen for Rasi. Mint canvas background. A narrow centred column (400px) near the top third: the brand mark (teal rounded square with 'R') and 'Rasi' above a white card with 12px corners and a hairline border. Card: title 'Sign in', one line 'Use the email and password your administrator gave you.', Email field, Password field with a show/hide eye icon, a full-width teal 'Sign in' button, and below a muted line 'Setting up a new business? Create one' with 'Create one' as a teal link. Show a critical message callout at the top of the card: 'That email and password don’t match. Try again, or ask your administrator to reset your password.' No hero, no illustration.

Create-your-business sign-up screen for Rasi, same centred layout as sign-in (brand mark above a white card, mint background).
